field_meaning.hi: RAM जो डेटाबेस के लिए तेज़ एक्सेस प्रदान करती है।

review_objections: NVIDIA: Definition is incorrect for database context. Primary storage in databases refers to main persistent storage (data files), not RAM. RAM is called memory/buffer pool/cache.
Google: Primary storage refers to RAM/Memory in general computer architecture, not specifically a database concept.
